summary: Built 1922 by area fire wardens on the Harriman estate in Sterling Forest; NRHP-listed 2006; closed to the public pending engineering inspection.

facts.design: 60-foot Aermotor LS-40 tower with 7x7-foot steel cab
facts.status_note: Still standing, but closed to the public while an engineering inspection is awaited.

access.note: Closed to the public pending an engineering inspection, per the NYS chapter's annual report (2023 activity) and an undated chapter homepage notice.

visit.trail_note: Several trails lead to the tower; it is closed, so it should not be climbed.

facts.agency: NY State Parks (Sterling Forest State Park)

events.note: Built in fall 1922 by area fire wardens on the Harriman family's Sterling Park estate; a January 1923 report says erection was still being completed; first used spring 1923
Peter Sarneckey begins his seventh season watching from the tower (March 1930 newspaper notice)
Tower and cabin improved; new access road bulldozed; phone line carried on 38 numbered cedar poles
Registered with the National Historic Lookout Register as US 102, NY 4
Placed on the historic register with the observers' cabin (register: June 12, 2006, under its Federal Register wording); the NPS National Register record gives 7/28/2006 as its publication date
Radio log of July 30, 2006 has the Sterling tower told of a Harriman fire past 700 acres with no control
Restoration project under way, aiming to reopen the tower to the public with a volunteer steward presence
Work parties replace all of the tower's lumber and repair the observers' cabin
Tower open 35 days; 16 volunteer stewards greeted over 800 visitors
Listed as currently closed pending engineering inspection in the chapter's annual report covering 2023; the report's date is not the closure date, and the start of closure is not in the sources read

corrections.proposed: NY State Parks (Sterling Forest State Park)
corrections.why: The register lists DEC only as a cooperator. The tower sits in Sterling Forest State Park, and register comments describe the state park as the body refusing volunteer help. Verify with NY State Parks before publishing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says built fall 1922 and first used spring 1923. A January 1923 state report says erection was still being completed, so the story says built 1922 and finished early 1923.
The register gives June 12, 2006 as the listing date. The NPS record gives 7/28/2006 as the publication date. Both agree on 2006.
Older reports call the ridge Sterling Mountain; the register comments say Rough Mountain. Both names refer to the same tower.

notes_for_editor: Story is built on the register page, the Forest Lookouts page, two NYS chapter documents, a 2006 radio log and the NPS record. Closure start date is not in any source read; the 2023 event year is the report date, not the closure date. The brief's 2017 closure, 2019 cab-window work and 2022 inspection-completed events were not verified in sources read and are left out. The chapter's annual report file is named cr-ny-2023 but its header reads Annual Report 2024; its content covers 2023. Agency correction (DEC to NY State Parks) needs confirming with OPRHP or NY State Parks. The register calls the listing a Federal Register placement; the story says 'historic register' for the June 12, 2006 date and cites the NPS National Register record for the 7/28/2006 publication date. The 2006 radio log's author is not identified. A fresh check of the tower's current status (reopening or inspection result) is advisable before publication.
